name: Chat Quote for WooCommerce
author: prokashsarker2026

sections.description:
Chat Quote for WooCommerce is an extension built for product inquiries and quote requests.

Features include:

  • WhatsApp buttons on product, shop, and cart pages.
  • A floating on-site chat widget with a messenger-style UI.
  • AJAX message storage in a custom database table.
  • Admin screens for messages and analytics.
  • Dashboard widget with click stats and top products.
  • WordPress Settings API integration.

The floating button opens a website chat widget first, then offers a WhatsApp fallback after the visitor sends a message.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chat-quote-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Configure settings under Chat Quote for WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. Chat Quote is built as a WooCommerce extension.

Does the plugin remove analytics on uninstall?

No. Uninstall removes plugin options only. Analytics tables remain in the database by default.
